procedures.name: SetGlobals
procedures.doc: Sets global consolidation parameters for XML import/export processing. Configures company, currency, and date range parameters for consolidation data exchange.

procedures.name: GetGlobals
procedures.doc: Retrieves global consolidation parameters from imported XML data. Returns company, currency, and date range information from XML consolidation file.

procedures.name: SetGLAccount
procedures.doc: Sets G/L Account data for XML export processing. Transfers temporary G/L account records to XML port data structure for consolidation export.

procedures.name: GetGLAccount
procedures.doc: Retrieves G/L Account data from imported XML for consolidation processing. Transfers G/L account data from XML port structure to temporary records for import processing.

procedures.name: SetGLEntry
procedures.doc: Sets G/L Entry data for XML export processing. Transfers temporary G/L entry records to XML port data structure for consolidation export.

procedures.name: GetGLEntry
procedures.doc: Retrieves G/L Entry data from imported XML for consolidation processing. Transfers G/L entry data from XML port structure to temporary records for import processing.

procedures.name: SetEntryDim
procedures.doc: Sets dimension buffer data for XML export processing. Transfers temporary dimension buffer records to XML port data structure for consolidation export.

procedures.name: GetEntryDim
procedures.doc: Retrieves dimension buffer data from imported XML for consolidation processing. Transfers dimension data from XML port structure to temporary records for import processing.

procedures.name: SetExchRate
procedures.doc: Sets currency exchange rate data for XML export processing. Transfers temporary exchange rate records to XML port data structure for consolidation export.

procedures.name: GetExchRate
procedures.doc: Retrieves currency exchange rate data from imported XML for consolidation processing. Transfers exchange rate data from XML port structure to temporary records for import processing.

procedures.name: SetICOutboxTrans
procedures.doc: Sets up the XmlPort for export by copying outbox transaction data to internal tables. Prepares all related transaction data including journal lines, sales documents, purchase documents, and dimensions.

procedures.name: GetICOutboxTrans
procedures.doc: Retrieves all IC outbox transaction records and inserts them into the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetICOutBoxJnlLine
procedures.doc: Retrieves all IC outbox journal line records and inserts them into the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetICIOBoxJnlDim
procedures.doc: Retrieves all IC inbox/outbox journal line dimension records and inserts them into the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetICOutBoxSalesHdr
procedures.doc: Retrieves all IC outbox sales header records and inserts them into the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetICOutBoxSalesLine
procedures.doc: Retrieves all IC outbox sales line records and inserts them into the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetICOutBoxPurchHdr
procedures.doc: Retrieves all IC outbox purchase header records and inserts them into the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetICOutBoxPurchLine
procedures.doc: Retrieves all IC outbox purchase line records and inserts them into the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetICSalesDocDim
procedures.doc: Retrieves IC sales document dimension records and transfers them to the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetICSalesDocLineDim
procedures.doc: Retrieves IC sales document line dimension records and transfers them to the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetICPurchDocDim
procedures.doc: Retrieves IC purchase document dimension records and transfers them to the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetICPurchDocLineDim
procedures.doc: Retrieves IC purchase document line dimension records and transfers them to the provided record variable.

procedures.name: GetFromICPartnerCode
procedures.doc: Returns the source IC partner code for the import/export operation.

procedures.name: GetToICPartnerCode
procedures.doc: Returns the destination IC partner code for the import/export operation.
